exposure: Discharge timing after cesarean section (24 hours vs. 72 hours)
finding: The study found that there was no difference in maternal hospital readmission between early (24 hours) and late (72 hours) discharge after cesarean section, but neonatal readmission was significantly higher in the early discharge group.
mod_finding: Late discharge after cesarean delivery was associated with significantly higher rates of initiating breastfeeding.
